companyUrls.title: LinkedIn company URLs or slugs
companyUrls.description: List of LinkedIn company pages to scrape. Each item is either a full company URL (e.g. 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/shopify') or a bare company slug (e.g. 'shopify'). Defaults to none — at least one is required. NOT for personal profiles, posts, or schools; use the matching profile/posts actor for those.

includePosts.title: Include recent company posts
includePosts.description: When true, each company record includes a 'recentPosts' array (post URL, date, text) published by the company page. Defaults to false to keep records small and cheap for AI agents. Does NOT change the per-company price.

maxCompanies.title: Max companies
maxCompanies.description: Hard ceiling on how many companies to scrape this run, after de-duplication. Accepts 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100. Caps both work and PPE spend — extra input URLs beyond this limit are ignored.
